## Template 1: Account Opening Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your FirstUK Bank Account Is Ready! 🎉  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your SmartSaver account with FirstUK Bank is now open and ready to use.

Account Details:
- Account Number: [ACC-XXXXX]
- Sort Code: 20-00-00
- Current Balance: £[amount]

What's Next:
1. Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login
2. Set up Two-Factor Authentication for security
3. Make your first deposit (transfer, branch, or standing order)
4. Download our mobile app for easy access

Your Current Rate:
Based on your balance, you're earning 4.50% AER on your SmartSaver.
Your first interest payment will arrive at the end of this month.

Questions?
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank
- Website: www.firstuk.bank/faq

Welcome to FirstUK Bank! We're delighted to have you.

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Customer Service
```

## Template 2: Interest Payment Notification  
**Subject:** Your Monthly Interest Payment — £[amount]  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Great news! Your monthly interest has been added to your account.

Interest Details:
- Amount: £[amount]
- Calculation: [Balance] × 4.50% AER ÷ 365 × [days]
- Effective Date: [date]
- New Balance: £[new balance]

Your Current Rate: 4.50% AER (applies to balances £0–£10,000)

If you'd like to increase your rate, consider depositing more:
- Balances £10,001–£50,000: 4.70% AER
- Balances £50,001+: 4.80% AER

View Your Account:
Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login to see your updated balance
and transaction history.

Questions about your interest? Contact us anytime:
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank

Thank you for banking with us!

FirstUK Bank Team

## Template 3: Rate Change Notification  
**Subject:** Your Interest Rate Has Changed  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

The Bank of England has changed its base rate, and your FirstUK
Bank interest rate has been updated.

What Changed:
- Previous Rate: [old rate]%
- New Rate: [new rate]%
- Effective Date: [date]

Why Did It Change?
Your SmartSaver rate is variable, which means it moves with the
Bank of England base rate. We maintain a fixed 2.5% margin above
BoE, so you're always competitive.

What This Means:
Your monthly interest will change starting next month. If rates
increased, you'll earn more. If they decreased, you'll earn less.

Example Calculation:
- Balance: £10,000
- Old Interest: ~£37.50/month
- New Interest: ~[new amount]/month

Not Happy With the Change?
If you'd prefer a fixed rate, we recommend our Fixed Rate Bonds
(coming 2026). Sign up for notifications at www.firstuk.bank/bonds

Questions?
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank
- View your account: www.firstuk.bank/login

Thank you for being a FirstUK Bank customer.

FirstUK Bank Team
```  
---

## Template 5: Failed Transaction Notification  
**Subject:** Your Transfer Failed — Here's Why  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your transfer of £[amount] to [recipient] could not be completed.

What Happened:
Reason: [Insufficient funds / Invalid account / Account closed / Other]

What This Means:
[Explanation tailored to reason - see below]

Next Steps:
[Solution tailored to reason - see below]

INSUFFICIENT FUNDS:
The transfer failed because your account balance is too low.
- Current Balance: £[amount]
- Transfer Amount: £[amount]
- You need: £[shortfall] more

Solution: Once you deposit enough funds, we can retry this transfer.
Just reply to this email or call 0800-555-2265 to proceed.

INVALID ACCOUNT:
The recipient's account details appear incorrect.
- Account Number: [number provided]

Solution: Double-check the account number with the recipient and
reply with the correct details. We'll resubmit immediately.

ACCOUNT CLOSED:
The recipient's account is no longer active.

Solution: Please contact the recipient to get their current account
details, then we can try again.

Questions?
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank

We're here to help!

FirstUK Bank Team
```  
---

## Template 6: Card Replacement Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your Replacement Card Is On Its Way  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your replacement card has been issued and is on its way.

Card Details:

- Replacement Reason: [Lost / Damaged / Expired / Other]

Contact us to arrange.

Questions?

- Email: support@firstuk.bank

Thank you,
FirstUK Bank Team

## Template 7: Complaint Acknowledgment  
**Subject:** We've Received Your Complaint — Reference [EXC-XXXXX]  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. We take your
complaint seriously and are committed to resolving it.

Your Complaint Reference: [EXC-XXXXX]
Date Received: [date and time]
Assigned To: [Investigator Name]

What Happens Next:
1. We will investigate your complaint thoroughly
2. We'll contact you if we need additional information
3. We will respond with our findings within 8 calendar days
4. You'll receive a full explanation and any resolution

Your Rights:
If you're unhappy with our response, you have the right to escalate
to the Financial Ombudsman Service:
- Phone: 0800 023 4567
- Website: www.financialombudsman.org.uk
- They're free and independent

Contact Us:
If you have any questions while we investigate:
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank (reference your complaint ID)

We appreciate your patience as we work to make this right.

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Complaints Team
```  
---

## Template 8: Complaint Resolution  
**Subject:** Resolution to Your Complaint [EXC-XXXXX]  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

We have completed our investigation into your complaint dated [date].

Complaint Reference: [EXC-XXXXX]

What We Found:
[Summary of investigation findings]

Our Decision:
[Uphold / Partially uphold / Reject]

Resolution:
[Action taken - refund, explanation, etc.]

Details:
[Specific details of resolution - refund amount, dates, etc.]

If You Accept This Resolution:
No further action is needed. Your refund (if applicable) has been
processed and will appear in your account within [timeframe].

If You Disagree With Our Decision:
You have the right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman Service
(free and independent):
- Phone: 0800 023 4567
- Website: www.financialombudsman.org.uk
- You have 6 months from this letter to escalate

Contact Us:
If you have questions, reply to this email or call 0800-555-2265
and reference your complaint ID.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Your feedback helps
us improve.

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Complaints Resolution Team
```

## Template 9: Password Reset Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your Password Has Been Reset Successfully  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your online banking password has been successfully reset.

Important Security Notes:
✓ Your new password is now active
✓ Your old password no longer works
✓ Log in at www.firstuk.bank/login with your new password
✓ Never share your password with anyone

If You Didn't Request This:
If you didn't reset your password, contact us immediately:
- Phone: 0800-555-2265 (24/7)
- Email: support@firstuk.bank

Security Reminder:
- Use a strong password (mix of letters, numbers, symbols)
- Change your password every 6 months
- Never reuse old passwords
- Log out after each session

Thank you,
FirstUK Bank Security Team
```

## Template 10: KYC Document Request  
**Subject:** Action Needed: Please Provide Your Identity Documents  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

We need you to provide some documentation to complete your account
verification (KYC - Know Your Customer).

What We Need:
Choose one:
- UK Passport (copy is fine)
- UK Driving License (copy is fine)

PLUS one of these for your address:
- Utility bill (dated within 3 months)
- Council tax letter
- Bank statement

How to Submit:
1. Upload securely: www.firstuk.bank/kyc-upload
2. Email: kyc@firstuk.bank
3. Visit a branch in person

Deadline: [date - typically 30 days]

Why This Matters:
Regulatory requirements ensure we're banking responsibly and
protecting your account.

Questions?
- Phone: 0800-555-2265
- Email: support@firstuk.bank

Thank you for your cooperation!

FirstUK Bank Compliance Team
```  
---

## Guidelines for All Templates  
**Tone:** Friendly, professional, clear, reassuring
**Personalization:** Always use customer's name
**Clarity:** Explain what happened in plain English
**Action Items:** Be clear about next steps
**Contact Info:** Always include support phone/email
**Brand:** Use FirstUK Bank logo and signature block
